notes_for_editor: Build year conflict unresolved: firelookout.com says the 20-foot pole L-4 tower was built in 1931; idahofirelookouts.com lists an L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower in 1934. Both give 1953 as destroyed. Height 6.1 m is converted from '20' pole' and may not be height to the cab floor; flagged, not verified. Forest name: firelookout.com says Nez Perce National Forest; Komoot uses Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests. Komoot is a recreation listing, used only to say the point is a rest area with no tower mentioned. Photo already on record (credit idahofirelookouts.com) is not a new find. Elevation 5003 ft is on both firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com and is now a facts key (elevation_ft). Story wording was changed so it does not copy the Idaho Fire Lookouts timeline line. No source describes the site today.
